name: Key Packaging Co
old_description: YOUR KEY PARTNER FOR CUSTOM INNOVATIVE THERMOFORMING SOLUTIONS
about:
Key Packaging Co operates from Sarasota, Florida, specializing in custom thin-gauge thermoformed plastic packaging. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides end-to-end thermoforming services, including design and prototyping, in-house mold and tool building, thermoforming production, supply chain management, and quality assurance. Its capabilities cover a range of industries requiring protective and shipping trays, as well as retail and medical packaging.

Key Packaging serves medical device, pharmaceutical, automotive, cosmetic, retail, electronics, and food packaging markets. Customers include manufacturers needing protective trays for automotive and industrial components, as well as medical and pharmaceutical packaging that meets stringent quality requirements.

The company emphasizes a Lean Six Sigma culture, staffing Black and Green Belt personnel, and maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification. A ship-to-stock program allows qualified customers to bypass incoming inspection, reflecting a focus on process consistency and reliability.
